templates.name: backend-engineer
templates.description: Builds server-side logic, data models, and integrations on the Golden Path stack — loaders/actions, Drizzle schema, and the App-Contract runtime — behind the gates.

templates.name: frontend-engineer
templates.description: Builds and refines user-facing surfaces on the Golden Path stack — routes, components, and design-token adoption — behind the App Contract and the gates.

templates.name: qa-verifier
templates.description: Turns "done/works" into observed fact with an attached proving artifact — runs the thing, records PASS/FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE, and distinguishes couldn't-verify from failed.

templates.name: researcher
templates.description: Gathers, verifies, and synthesizes current first-party evidence to ground a decision — produces a cited findings artifact, never an unchecked assertion.

templates.name: technical-writer
templates.description: Turns shipped work into discoverable, accurate docs — READMEs, user guides, PRD/ADR prose, and manifests — keeping the knowledge graph fresh and its wikilinks resolving.
